text: {"covered":[{"point_id":"q3a_definition","quote":"A buffer is a temporary storage area in main memory that holds data while it is transferred between two devices of different speeds"},{"point_id":"q3a_function_speed","quote":"it compensates for the difference in speed between the CPU and slower I/O devices"},{"point_id":"q3a_function_io","quote":"it reduces the number of I/O operations by transferring data in blocks"},{"point_id":"q3b_formula","quote":"Number of buffers = file size / buffer size"},{"point_id":"q3b_substitution","quote":"90 / 80 = 1.125"},{"point_id":"q3b_answer","quote":"so we round up to 2 buffers"},{"point_id":"q3c_conversion","quote":"First convert the units: 2 GB = 2048 MB"},{"point_id":"q3c_division","quote":"2048 / 512 = 4"},{"point_id":"q3c_answer","quote":"4 buffers"}]}
